metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Suspect: The Shooting of Jean Charles de Menezes
metas.description: Police pursue suspects in failed bombing attempts. Innocent Brazilian man is misidentified as a suspect and shot dead by police. Police are found guilty in his death. Police Commissioner resigns.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · The Remarried Empress
metas.description: Empress Navier is shocked when her husband seeks divorce to wed his mistress. Refusing defeat, she allies with enigmatic Prince Heinrey, risking all to reclaim her throne and outshine her ex amid palace intrigue and romance.
